phase_name: Extract the guard into a shared helper module

objectives.description: Create shared _bimodal_harness.py helper module with BH_AVAILABLE/BH_SKIP_REASON
Update test_cross_oracle_differential.py to import from shared module, unify skip messages
Verify import resolves, baseline counts identical before/after, blocker skip behavior clean, Phase 1 tests still RED

approaches_tried.approach: Relative package import bimodal_logic.tests._bimodal_harness (not a fragile sys.path-based import)
approaches_tried.reason: oracle/ has no __init__.py so it lands on sys.path under pytest's prepend import mode, and bimodal_logic/ and bimodal_logic/tests/ both have __init__.py, making the absolute-within-package import resolve cleanly. Fallback (duplicating the helper) was not needed.
